home.hero_title: Find the right loan scheme for your work
home.hero_sub: Answer a few questions by voice or by typing. We check the rules, work out your payments and find a lender near you.
home.how_1: Speak or type in your language
home.how_2: See schemes you qualify for, with reasons
home.how_3: Send your file to a nearby lender and track it by SMS
home.privacy_note: Your details are used only to find and apply for a loan scheme. You can delete them any time.
